sentences.text:
Standing Counsel
 Mr.A. K. Das, Advocate for the
 informant.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Mr. A. K. Das, learned counsel enters appearance by filing his Vakalatnama on behalf of the informant, which is taken on record.

Heard learned counsel for the appellant, leaned counsel for the State as well the learned counsel for the informant.
This is an appeal under section 14-A of S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act, 1989 in connection with C.T. (Spl.)
Case No.61 of 2022 arising out of Motanga P.S. Case No.246 of 2022 // 2 // pending in the Court of learned Judge, Special Court, Dhenkanal for offences punishable under sections 376(2)(k)/376(2)(l)/506 of the Indian Penal Code read with sections 3(1)(r)(s)/3(2)(v)(va) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 The appellant moved an application for bail before the Court of learned Judge, Special Court,
Dhenkanal, which was rejected on 04.01.2023.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is in judicial custody since 05.11.2022 and charge sheet has been submitted under sections 376(2)(k)/376(2)(l)/506 of the Indian Penal Code read with sections 3(1)(r)(s)/3(2)(v) (va) of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act and after going through the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim placed by the learned counsel for the State and also the medical examination report of the victim as well as on hearing the learned counsel for the informant, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Let the appellant be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) each with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper with further conditions that he shall appear before // 3 // the learned trial Court on each date to which the case would be posted for trial, shall not try to tamper with the prosecution evidence and shall not try to come in contact with the victim.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
The CRLA is accordingly disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy of this order on proper application.

( S.K. Sahoo) Judge Sipun Bolla Srinibash Gangadhar vs State Of Odisha & Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81997615/
